name: Telegram Death Notifier
description: Sends a death screenshot to a Telegram channel

telegram-title.name: Telegram
telegram-title.description: Posting is opt-in: turn it on per level in the pause-menu Runs tab.

bot-token.name: Bot token
bot-token.description: Always hidden. Clear removes the token after applying changes. Stored locally; masking is not encryption.

msg-run.name: Run message
msg-run.description: Startpos, practice or noclip segment. Placeholders: {player}, {start}, {end}, {level}

msg-best.name: New best message
msg-best.default: {player} got a new best of {percent}% on {level}!

msg-streak-same.name: Streak message (same run)
msg-streak-same.description: Same run in a row. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {run}, {count}

msg-streak-mixed.name: Streak message (different runs)
msg-streak-mixed.description: Different runs in a row. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {runs}, {count}

streak-enabled.name: Post streaks
streak-enabled.description: Progresses in a row with no plain death in between.

streak-min.name: Streak: post from
streak-min.description: How many progresses in a row start a streak (2 or more, no upper limit).

streak-mode.name: Streak message mode
streak-mode.description: Separate: run photo, then streak text. Replace: streak caption only. Combine: one caption with both.

custom-nickname.name: Use custom nickname
custom-nickname.description: Use the nickname below instead of your GD username

show-decimals.name: Show decimals
show-decimals.description: Off: truncate both endpoints to whole percentages. On: round and display the chosen number of decimal places for calculations and messages.

decimal-places.name: Decimal places
decimal-places.description: Number of digits after the decimal point in percentages (1-4).

only-best.name: Only new bests
only-best.description: Death % per start pos mode only: normal deaths from 0%. Does not restrict practice, checkpoint runs or run length mode.

skewed-screenshot.name: Skewed screenshot
skewed-screenshot.description: Recreates the old diagonal render bug.

skew-strength.name: Skew strength
skew-strength.description: Shift per row, in hundredths of a pixel.
